spans.s:
r. 9th cl. (मृद्नाति)
1 To grind, to powder, to reduce to dust or powder.
2 To trample on, to tread under foot.

f. (-दा)
Earth, clay, soil.
E.
मृद to trample on, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

f. (मृद् मृत्)
1 Earth, soil, clay.
2 A fragrant earth.
E.
मृद to trample on, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-रः)
The green pigeon, (Columba hariala, BUC.)

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A tabour, a small drum.
2 A double drum.
3 A sound, a noise.
4 A bambu.
E.
मृद to be trampled on, to be beat, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्; also with कन् added मृदङ्गक.

m. (-लः)
The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
E.
मृदङ्ग a drum, and फल a fruit; perhaps alluding to its size and shape.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Sportive, sporting.
2 Passing quickly away, transient.
E.
मृ to die, दर Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
The thunderbolt.
E.
मृदा earth, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Rubbed, ground.
2 Trodden or trampled on.
E.
मृद to reduce to powder, aff. क्त.

f. (-नी)
Good soil or earth.
E.
मृद् earth, इनि aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.

Soft.
2

Blunt, not sharp.
3 Gentle, mild.
f. (-द्वी)
The brown grape.
E.
म्रद to rub, aff. कु, and the semivowel changed to its congener.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A man of lax bowels, one easily affected by medicine.
E.
मृदु, and कोष्ठ intestinal canal.

f. (-ना)
A goose, a swan.
E.
मृदु soft, and गमन going.

m. (-र्म्मी)
The Bhojpatra tree.
E.
मृदु soft, चर्म्म skin or bark, इनि aff.

m. (-दः)
1 The Bhojpatra or birch tree.
2 A kind of Pīlu, or tree growing in the hills.
E.
मृदु soft, and च्छद covering or bark.

f. (-ता)
Softness.
E.
तल् added to मृदु; also with त्व, मृदुत्वं.

m. (-चः)
The Bhojpatra or birch tree, the bark of which peels off, and is used in making Hooka-snakes, &c.
E.
मृदु soft, and त्वच skin; also with a final consonant मृदुत्वच्, (-त्वक्.)

n. (-कं)
Gold.

n. (-र्व्व)
A cane or ratan.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Having a soft and delicate hand.
E.
मृदु, and पाणि hand.

m. (-ष्पः)
The Sirisha tree, (Mimosa sirisha.)
E.
मृदु soft, and पुष्प flower.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Soft.
n. (-लं)
Water.
E.
मृदु soft, and लच् aff.

m. (-वान्)
A hare.
E.
मृदु soft, रोमन् hair, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
A hare.
E.
मृदु soft, लोभ hair, and कन् added.

m. (-तः)
A gentle breeze, zephyr.
E.
मृदु soft, and वात wind.

n. (-लं)
The blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea)
E.
मृदु soft, and उत्पल a lotus.

n. (-ण्डं)
An earthen vessel.
E.
मृत्, and भाण्ड vessel.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Of soft or tender frame or body.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A delicate woman.
n. (-ङ्गं)
Tin.
E.
मृदु soft, and अङ्ग body, substance.

f. (-का)
A grape.
E.
मृद to hurt, कीकन् aff., and उक् augment.
